Truck causes three fatal accidents in Kushinagar

A truck caused three separate fatal accidents on the Padrauna-Kaptan-ganj highway in Kushinagar on Friday. The accidents resulted in the deaths of three individuals: 45-year-old Motilal, 17-year-old Chandresh, and 35-year-old Subhash. The truck driver was apprehended by locals and taken into custody. The victims' ages were reported as 45, 17, and 35.
